data.name: Landing.Logistics.1PL
data.value: The company manages its own logistics: warehouses, transport and operational processes.

data.name: Landing.Logistics.2PL
data.value: Separate service providers handle specific parts of transport or warehousing.

data.name: Landing.Logistics.3PL
data.value: One logistics partner coordinates a broader package of logistics services.

data.name: Landing.Logistics.4PL
data.value: The full supply chain model is managed by connecting processes, partners and data.

data.name: Landing.Glossary.Kpi.Body
data.value: A measured process state or result.

data.name: Landing.Glossary.Sla.Body
data.value: Agreed commitments for quality, time or service delivery.

data.name: Landing.Glossary.Throughput.Body
data.value: The number of operations or units processed per unit of time.

data.name: Landing.Sector.Transport
data.value: Transport types, route points and delivery terms.

data.name: Landing.Sector.DistributionModel
data.value: How goods move from the central warehouse to branches and customers.

data.name: Landing.Sector.Warehousing
data.value: Warehouse flow from receiving to outbound dispatch.

data.name: Landing.Sector.Packing
data.value: Packing service, controls and operational flow principles.

data.name: Landing.Sector.Glossary
data.value: Short terms used in logistics and internal systems.

data.name: Landing.Sector.Kpi
data.value: Indicators, targets and how they turn into actions.

data.name: Landing.Transport.Jumbo.Body
data.value: JUMBO is used when cargo volume matters as much as weight. It suits lighter goods that take more space.

data.name: Landing.Transport.Tilt.Body
data.value: TILT is a curtain-side vehicle that can be loaded from the side, rear or top when goods do not require temperature control.

data.name: Landing.Transport.Multitemp.Body
data.value: MULTITEMP allows goods with different temperature requirements to move in one vehicle by separating zones.

data.name: Landing.Transport.SmallTruck.Body
data.value: A small distribution truck is used for city and regional deliveries where flexibility, frequent stops and limited cargo volume matter.

data.name: Landing.Transport.Van.Body
data.value: A small cargo van suits small consignments and tobacco distribution. It usually fits around 1-2 EUR pallets, so it works well on routes with many delivery points.

data.name: Landing.Transport.Poi.Body
data.value: POI is a specific point on a route: a customer, ramp, warehouse or another location where an action happens.

data.name: Landing.Transport.Drop.Body
data.value: DROP marks a delivery or unloading action at a specific point. A route may contain one or many DROP points.

data.name: Landing.Distribution.Ibl.Body
data.value: IBL truck flow moves goods from the central warehouse in Kaunas district to branches: Vilnius, Panevezys, Utena, Siauliai and Klaipeda.

data.name: Landing.Distribution.Dst.Body
data.value: DST flow uses smaller vehicles from Kaunas and the branches to deliver goods to customers by routes and delivery points.

data.name: Landing.Warehousing.Inbound.Body
data.value: Inbound covers checking arriving goods, registration, quality control and preparation for storage.

data.name: Landing.Warehousing.Storage.Body
data.value: Storage depends on location control, batches, expiry dates, turnover and goods availability for operations.

data.name: Landing.Warehousing.Outbound.Body
data.value: Outbound covers order picking, checking, loading and handover to transport according to the delivery plan.

data.name: Landing.Packing.Service.Body
data.value: Packing can include repacking, kit assembly, sticker work, labeling and other product preparation operations.

data.name: Landing.Packing.Control.Body
data.value: Clear standards, material accounting, quantity confirmation and error tracking are important for control.

data.name: Landing.Packing.Flow.Body
data.value: Packing work is planned by demand, work standard, people capacity and the final delivery deadline.

data.name: Landing.Kpi.What.Body
data.value: A KPI is an agreed indicator that helps show whether a process is moving in the intended direction.

data.name: Landing.Kpi.Target.Body
data.value: An indicator needs a clear calculation rule, target and actual value so the deviation can be assessed.

data.name: Landing.Kpi.Action.Body
data.value: A KPI is not only a number. It should help make a decision, adjust a process or confirm that the direction is good.

data.name: Landing.Glossary.Sku.Body
data.value: A unique product or item identifier used to manage stock, movement, prices and orders.

data.name: Landing.Glossary.Lifo.Body
data.value: An inventory logic where the latest received goods or batch are issued first.

data.name: Landing.Glossary.Fifo.Body
data.value: An inventory logic where the earliest received goods or batch are issued first. Often important for expiry and stock rotation.

data.name: Landing.Glossary.Asn.Body
data.value: An advance message about an incoming shipment: what is arriving, in what quantities, when and under which documents.

data.name: Landing.Glossary.Grn.Body
data.value: A goods receipt record or document confirming that goods were received and registered in the warehouse.

data.name: Landing.Glossary.Po.Body
data.value: A purchasing document stating what is bought, in what quantity, at what price and under which conditions.

data.name: Landing.Glossary.Rfid.Body
data.value: Identification by radio frequency, where goods, pallets or locations are read through RFID tags without direct barcode scanning.

data.name: Landing.Glossary.Bom.Body
data.value: A list of materials or components required to make a product, kit, packing setup or another operation.

data.name: Landing.Glossary.Erp.Body
data.value: A business system connecting finance, purchasing, sales, inventory, production or other core company processes.

data.name: Landing.Glossary.Wms.Body
data.value: A warehouse management system controlling locations, stock, receiving, picking, replenishment and outbound dispatch.

data.name: Landing.Glossary.Abc.Body
data.value: Grouping stock or products by importance, turnover or value so control effort is focused on the most important items.

data.name: Landing.Glossary.Ltl.Body
data.value: A partial load where one shipment does not fill the whole truck and may be consolidated with other shipments.

data.name: Landing.Glossary.Ftl.Body
data.value: A full load where a vehicle or trailer is dedicated to one customer, route or shipment.

data.name: Landing.Glossary.ThirdPl.Body
data.value: A logistics partner coordinating a broader service package, such as warehousing, transport and order management.

data.name: Landing.Glossary.Otif.Body
data.value: A metric showing whether an order was delivered on time and in the full agreed quantity.

data.name: Landing.Glossary.Eta.Body
data.value: The expected arrival time of a vehicle, shipment or goods.

data.name: Landing.Glossary.Pod.Body
data.value: Delivery confirmation: a document, signature, digital record or other evidence that the load was delivered.

data.name: Landing.Glossary.Mrp.Body
data.value: Planning material needs based on demand, production, inventory and purchasing lead times.

data.name: Landing.Glossary.Rfq.Body
data.value: A request to a supplier or partner to provide price, terms and availability for a specific service or product.
